The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 eeb5895c7058765f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 77. statement: Almost surely, the closure in L2(µh) of the smooth form 1 2E0 has domain Dh = Rµh (H1 (S2 , vol0)), Eh(Rµh f, Rµh g) = 1 2 E0 (f, g). (8.21) It is a densely defined closed regular Dirichlet form. Let Ah be its nonnegative self-adjoint operator, and set Bh = 2Ah, the operator of the raw form E0. Put µ = µh and define Gµ(x, y) = G(x, y) − Z G(x, z) dµ(z) − Z G(z, y) dµ(z) + ZZ G(z, w) dµ(z) dµ(w), (8.22) Khg(x) = Z Gµ(x, y)g(y) dµ(y). (8.23) The kernel Gµ is in L2(µ ⊗ µ) and has zero µ-mean in each variable. The operator Kh is zero on constants and is the positive, injective inverse of Bh on L2 0(µ), the subspace of µ-mean-zero functions. Both Bh and Ah have compact resolvent. On the infinite-dimensional space L2(µ) their eigenvalues, counted with multiplicity, can be written 0 = ν0 < ν1 ≤ ν2 ≤ · · · −→ ∞, Λj = νj 2 (j ≥ 0), respectively. The constant eigenfunction is the only zero mode, and X j≥1 ν−2 j = ∥Kh∥2 HS < ∞, Tr e−tAh = 1 + X j≥1 e−tνj/2 < ∞ (t > 0). (8.24) The heat series converges locally uniformly on (0, ∞). The ordered eigenvalues and this Cloc((0, ∞)) heat trace have Borel versions as functions of the area measure in the fixed sphere coordinate. The form and these readouts are invariant under conformal or anticon- formal changes of that coordinate.
